elyza.core.data module#

A data registry containing all relevant input functionality, sampling, etc.

Defines the Input base class and its ScalarInput and VectorInput specializations, which describe the inputs of an Evaluator and know how to draw samples from themselves given a PRNG key.

class elyza.core.data.Input(*, name: int | str = 'anonymous', dim: int = 1, sampling_func: Annotated[callable, SkipValidation()] | None = None)[source]#

Bases: BaseModel

Base class for a named, sampleable model input.

name#

Unique input name.

Type:

int | str

dim#

Dimension of the input.

Type:

int

sampling_func#

Function that takes a single PRNG key and returns one sample; used by sample() to draw a batch of samples.

Type:

Annotated[callable, pydantic.functional_validators.SkipValidation()] | None

model_config = {'arbitrary_types_allowed': True}#

Configuration for the model, should be a dictionary conforming to [ConfigDict][pydantic.config.ConfigDict].

print()[source]#

Print the input’s name, dimension, and concrete type.

sample(key, n_points: int) → Array[source]#

Draw a batch of samples from sampling_func.

Parameters:

  • key – A JAX PRNG key, split internally into n_points subkeys (one per sample).

  • n_points – Number of samples to draw.

Returns:

Samples of shape (n_points, dim).

Return type:

jax.Array

Raises:

AssertionError – If no sampling_func has been set.
